sentences.text: Hydrorion is a member of the family Plesiosauridae, a group of marine reptiles known for their long necks and flippers.
The genus contains only one species, H. brachypterygius, which was originally classified under Plesiosaurus and later Microcleidus before its current name was established.
The largest known specimen of this animal reached an impressive length of 4 meters.
This genus received its modern name from Großmann in 2007, separating it from earlier classifications.
Fossils of Hydrorion were discovered within the Posidonia Shale deposits located in south-western Germany.
These creatures lived during the Toarcian Age of the Lower Jurassic period.
